title: Marquis del Vasto to Charles V, Rome, early December 1527, BnF fr. 3022 no. 6 (Cipher 2; catalogue item 7)

plaintext.source: Lasry's 2026 preliminary letter-level decryption ('Gasto-Charles V Cipher 2', cryptiana GL.htm), prior/BnF_fr3022_f16_decryption.txt, with code groups and syllable signs identified here from context (n6_reading.md 18 Sept; n6_signs.tsv 22 Sept 2026).

transcription.source: Lasry's decryption kept as a sign-level token list (one token per cipher sign, his labels) in n6_signs.tsv; checked against the Gallica images (views 32-34) wherever a reading turns on the glyph; 5 signs he left out (the 'at quia' switch markers on f. 17r) added from the image.
transcription.notes: 1,680 tokens = Lasry's 1,675 for ff. 16v-17v ('_' and <plaintext> dropped) + 5 from the image; counted by n6_measure.py, which also checks the token stream against Lasry's file. _check_profile.py --measure does not apply (the file is a reading table, not a bare ciphertext).

system.summary: Caesar-shifted substitution (+1) over a 21-letter alphabet with homophones, three-letter b-/c-/d- code groups, and two-per-syllable code signs (Lasry's 'Gasto-Charles V Cipher 2').
system.sibling_key: No. 6 shares Lasry's Cipher 2 key with no. 19 (ff. 40-43, 6 Nov 1527), used for code contexts.
system.notes: Split 14 Oct 2026: no. 20 and the Ranzo letters (a different, initial-letter code) are targets/ranzo1528/; no. 10 is in Cipher 1, a third system, read by Lasry and Tomokiyo and not reworked.

prior_solution.where: cryptiana GL.htm: Lasry 2026 preliminary letter-level decryption of no. 6 (Cipher 2), with its key; Lasry 2023 / Tomokiyo 2026 reading of no. 10 (Cipher 1, a different cipher, not part of this target).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: sign-level reading file and measure (n6_signs.tsv, n6_measure.py)

solution.what: Fetched fr. 3022 (Gallica btv1b90601558) and identified the three catalogue pieces and folios.
Found no. 10 already solved by Lasry (2023) with Tomokiyo's edited text (2026), and Lasry's 2026 preliminary decryption of Cipher 2 covering no. 6 and no. 19.
Checked Lasry's no. 6 decryption against the f. 16v ciphertext (dʃfp = creo, nnbt = mas, qʃftxp = presto); identified no. 6 as del Vasto's own letter of early Dec 1527.

Identified about 40 b-/c-/d- code groups of no. 6 from context across nos. 6 and 19 (doz = Lautreque, deh = la Marca, dnb = dinero …) and made an edited reading (n6_reading.md); about 15 codes and some stretches open.

Kept Lasry's no. 6 decryption as a sign-level token list with a reading and status per token run (n6_signs.tsv); n6_measure.py checks the stream against Lasry's file and counts. Added the 5 'at quia' signs he left in <plaintext>.
First measurement of no. 6: Lasry's key alone 1,555/1,680 = 92.6%; with the 18 Sept code identifications 1,595/1,680 = 94.9%. The 18 Sept verdict 'read' had been unmeasured.

Checked the syllable-code signs on views 32-34 where a reading turned on the glyph: Lasry's two-per-syllable labels merge different signs. boz = esto (not fin), bab = mas, bar = tan, bop = como, bopt = ellos (Lasry 'con s'), bie = el (Lasry 'al'), bis = de, bep = es or en; <37> at 17va.11 is r.

Context readings (grade I): da = otro (not liga; nosotros, 'otro fruto'), dop = tiempo (not invierno), dab = tiene(n), <37> = final(mente), stop sign; 'at' and 'quia' identified as clear/cipher switch markers at every boundary in nos. 6 and 19.

Scanned no. 19 ff. 41r-41v on the images for the open groups; bet = dello from 'el poco cuidado que [bet] he' (f. 41v) fits no. 6 'exercito [bet]s tan pujante'. ff. 41-43 not transcribed in full; no other open group found.
Re-measured no. 6: 1,646/1,680 = 98.0% read; 11 nomenclator tokens (10 types: dnh, bnq, rar, car, cny, bny, beb, bnc, ge+, der at 17va.2) and 23 other tokens in 9 short stretches open.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1631 tokens, 65 types, es-golden-age order 4: reading -1.931 per letter; random keys -4.675 (z 7.3); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.049 (mean -3.084, z 39.4); annealer on the real text -1.921. Verdict: pass.

Split the combined catalogue item 7 target after George Lasry pointed out that it mixed different ciphers: del Vasto's no. 6 (Cipher 2, shifted letters with code groups; sibling no. 19) stays in vasto1527; no. 20 and the Ranzo letters (initial-letter code with numbered word lists) moved to ranzo1528; no. 10 (Cipher 1, read by Lasry and Tomokiyo, not reworked) is a cross-reference only.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): Lasry's preliminary decryption (prior/, his file) and, as separate files, this project's sign-level reading file n6_signs.tsv, its current reading of the cipher runs (texts/no6_decryption.txt, saved from n6_measure.py --text) and the 18 Sept edited reading; key = Lasry's key image plus the code values added here, copied from NOTES to texts/key.md.

Transcribed the cipher passages of no. 19 ff. 41r-42r (Gallica views 80-82), never transcribed before: 63 lines, 612 groups (n19_transcription.txt), in two passes (n19_passA.txt 1:1 crops, n19_passB.txt 0.6-scale strips, same reader, not consulting pass A); 4 lines differed, settled on the image.

Pre-registered held-out check of Lasry's Cipher 2 letter key on no. 19 ff. 41r-42r, which neither his key nor this target's code values had seen (PREREG_n19.md, n19_decode.py, n19_measure.md): 232 letter-only words, share in the Spanish lexicon 0.591 against 200 shuffled keys (mean 0.045, best 0.164); threshold >= 0.50 and >= best + 0.30: pass. Strict count of the portion by sense 565/612 = 0.923.

New contexts for the open no. 6 groups, value set frozen (SHA-256) before counting: rar is the destination of the imperial army's march (f. 40v, where Lasry's 'de no de' is [rar]; f. 42r 'procuraremos que se vaya la buelta de [rar]'), Florencia or Toscana; cnt 'salir en [cnt] manera' (alguna or otra); bnq 'si [bnq]'; dnh 'la [der] [dnh] que tienen'. None settled; car, cny, bny, beb, bnc, ge+ do not occur in ff. 41r-42r. No. 6 count unchanged (0.980).

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -1.888; polyphony 0.04; 49 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -1.921

outcome.method_basis: No. 6 was read with Lasry's 2026 preliminary decryption and key for 'Gasto-Charles V Cipher 2' (cryptiana GL.htm), extended with about 40 code groups from context and glyph checks (92.6% to 98.0%).
outcome.fraction_read_source: No. 6: 1,646 of 1,680 cipher tokens read (n6_signs.tsv via n6_measure.py, 98.0%).

gaps.item: No. 6 code groups dnh, bnq, rar (x2), car, cny, bny, beb, bnc, ge+, der at 17va.2 (11 tokens)
gaps.detail: One to three contexts each, none fixing a value. No. 19 ff. 41r-42r transcribed 14 Nov 2026 (n19_transcription.txt): rar is the destination of the imperial army's march (f. 40v, f. 42r), Florencia or Toscana; cnt 'salir en [cnt] manera' (alguna or otra); bnq 'si [bnq]'; dnh 'la [der] [dnh] que tienen'; car, cny, bny, beb, bnc, ge+ do not occur there. ge+ perhaps a stop.

gaps.item: No. 6 nine short stretches (23 tokens): 'y y por [mq]', 'es [en de las los]', '[es de] otro exercito', 'servira [que de con]', 'ira [que l] camino', '[der de] pais', 'en [cnt] parte', 'esperar [es]', 'apuntamiento [es]'
gaps.detail: Signs transcribed but the syllable-sign values do not make sense there; Lasry's labels probably merge different glyphs. Needs glyph-level retranscription.

outcome.notes: No. 6 read (98.0% measured, 22 Sept 2026; was 'read' unmeasured on 18 Sept). Grades: 34 values inferred from context (24 code groups, 8 syllable signs, 2 switch markers); Lasry's letter key is taken as it stands. Until 14 Oct 2026 this target also held no. 10 (Cipher 1) and no. 20 with the Ranzo letters (now targets/ranzo1528/). 14 Nov 2026: no. 19 ff. 41r-42r transcribed (612 groups) and decoded with Lasry's key unchanged; pre-registered held-out check passed (lexicon share 0.591 vs best of 200 shuffled keys 0.164); portion read 0.923 by sense; no new code value, no. 6 unchanged.

credits.note: Gasto-Charles V Cipher 2 key and preliminary decryption of no. 6 (and f. 40), cryptiana GL.htm

texts.label: No. 6, BnF fr. 3022 ff. 16v-17v, del Vasto to Charles V, [Rome, early December 1527]: George Lasry's preliminary decryption, and this project's reading
texts.summary: The Marquis del Vasto to Charles V from Rome, early December 1527, after the agreement for the Pope's liberty: his plan to take the army out of Rome toward Tuscany, secure Siena, threaten Florence, take Perugia and the state of Urbino and pass into the Marche, with the warning that the army cannot be sustained 'desta manera' without money. prior/BnF_fr3022_f16_decryption.txt is George Lasry's preliminary letter-level decryption (cryptiana GL.htm), which also serves as the sign transcription; texts/no6_decryption.txt is this project's current reading of the cipher runs with the code groups identified (98.0% of 1,680 tokens), and n6_reading.md its edited text of 18 Sept.
